content.json:
# HUDHUD control room
Every match the court narrates, as Application Insights saw it: what aired, what the Critic refused and why, what the models cost, and anything that went wrong. Synthetic matches only.

content.query:
let m = requests | where name == "match" | extend cost = todouble(customDimensions["hudhud.cost_usd"]);
let a = dependencies | where name startswith "alert " | extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.outcome"]), refused = toint(customDimensions["hudhud.rejections"]), checked = toint(customDimensions["hudhud.numbers_checked"]), air_ms = todouble(customDimensions["hudhud.latency_ms"]);
union
  (m | summarize Value = tostring(count()) | extend Metric = "Matches", Order = 1),
  (a | summarize Value = tostring(countif(outcome == "verified")) | extend Metric = "Cues verified and aired", Order = 2),
  (a | summarize Value = tostring(sum(refused)) | extend Metric = "Claims the Critic refused", Order = 3),
  (a | summarize Value = tostring(countif(outcome != "verified")) | extend Metric = "Alerts not aired as verified", Order = 4),
  (a | summarize Value = tostring(sum(checked)) | extend Metric = "Numbers the Critic checked", Order = 5),
  (a | where outcome == "verified" and isnotnull(air_ms) | summarize Value = strcat(tostring(round(percentile(air_ms, 50) / 1000, 1)), " s") | extend Metric = "Alert to air (median)", Order = 6),
  (m | summarize Value = strcat("$", tostring(round(sum(cost), 4))) | extend Metric = "Model cost", Order = 7),
  (m | where cost > 0 | summarize Value = strcat("$", tostring(round(avg(cost), 4))) | extend Metric = "Cost per model-narrated match", Order = 8)
| order by Order asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: The match day so far

content.query:
dependencies | where name startswith "alert "
| summarize Alerts = count() by Outcome = tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.outcome"])
content.title: What became of each alert

content.query:
dependencies | where name startswith "alert "
| mv-expand code = split(tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.rejection_codes"]), ",") to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(code)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Reason = code
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: Why the Critic refused claims
content.noDataMessage: The Critic refused nothing in this range.

content.query:
dependencies | where name startswith "alert "
| summarize Alerts = count() by Kind = tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.alert.kind"]), Outcome = tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.outcome"])
content.title: Alerts by kind and outcome

content.query:
requests | where name == "match"
| where isnotempty(customDimensions["hudhud.cost_usd"])
| project timestamp, Match = strcat(tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.match_id"]), " at ", format_datetime(timestamp, "HH:mm")), ["Cost (USD)"] = todouble(customDimensions["hudhud.cost_usd"])
| order by timestamp asc
| project Match, ["Cost (USD)"]
content.title: Model cost per match

content.query:
dependencies
| where name startswith "chat "
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.request.model"])
| summarize Calls = count(),
    ["p50 latency (s)"] = round(percentile(duration, 50) / 1000, 2),
    ["p95 latency (s)"] = round(percentile(duration, 95) / 1000, 2),
    ["Input tokens"] = sum(toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"])),
    ["Output tokens"] = sum(toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])),
    ["Of which reasoning"] = sum(toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens"])),
    Failures = countif(success == false)
  by Model = model
content.title: The models at work

content.query:
dependencies
| where name startswith "chat "
| summarize ["p50 (ms)"] = percentile(duration, 50), ["p95 (ms)"] = percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
content.title: Model latency

content.query:
dependencies
| where name has "upsert_item"
| summarize Writes = count(), ["p95 (ms)"] = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0), Failures = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
content.title: The audit trail (Cosmos DB writes)

content.json:
## What went wrong
Alerts that didn't air as verified, a backup model taking over, and any failed call. An empty table means nothing went wrong.

content.query:
union
  (dependencies | where name startswith "alert " | where tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.outcome"]) != "verified"
    | project timestamp, What = strcat("Alert ", tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.alert.id"]), ": ", tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.outcome"])), Detail = tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.rejection_codes"]), operation_Id),
  (requests | where name == "match" | where toint(customDimensions["hudhud.handovers"]) > 0
    | project timestamp, What = "The backup model took over", Detail = strcat(tostring(customDimensions["hudhud.handovers"]), " handovers"), operation_Id),
  (dependencies | where success == false and target != "169.254.169.254"  // the VM metadata probe, off Azure
    | project timestamp, What = strcat("Failed: ", name), Detail = tostring(resultCode), operation_Id)
| order by timestamp desc
content.noDataMessage: Nothing went wrong in this range.
